'''Rob Terrio Echo Base Operations Deck''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on Decipher Deck Designs.

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Rob Terrio]]
* '''Published:''' March 1997 (Decipher Deck Designs)
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Hoth]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[Hoth: Echo Command Center (War Room)]]
* '''Strategy:''' Echo Base Operations Deck
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PHoth Echo Base Operations Deck Terrio L.txt |Download]]
